page: Alibaba Cloud ecs.sn2.7xlarge is a general-purpose virtual machine instance powered by the KVM hypervisor. It features 32 dedicated vCPUs derived from 16 physical cores of an Intel Xeon 8163 processor running at 2.5 GHz. The system is equipped with 128.0 GB of RAM, providing a balanced allocation of 4.0 GB per core. It does not include local storage or dedicated GPU hardware, relying entirely on network-attached storage. Network connectivity is rated at a baseline bandwidth of 6 Gbps.

Benchmark data indicates a clear performance divergence between single-core and multi-core operations. Single-core performance is weak, with stress-ng and Geekbench single-core scores falling into the bottom 25%, and single-threaded gzip compression ranking in the bottom 10%. Conversely, multi-core capabilities are average, as demonstrated by stress-ng multi-core, PassMark CPU, and Geekbench multi-core scores. Memory bandwidth benchmarks for large blocks are average, though the PassMark memory score is weak.

This resource profile is suited for workloads that can leverage parallel processing to offset the lower single-core speeds. Appropriate applications include multi-threaded database operations, static web serving, and medium-sized language model inference, where prompt processing and text generation speeds perform in the middle tier. From a qualitative cost-efficiency perspective, the instance offers a high density of dedicated vCPUs and memory for parallelized enterprise workloads, though the lack of local storage requires accounting for external storage performance and costs.
